tool_description: Show or deterministically update the authenticated owner's persistent GHOST prompt-builder settings. Supported actions are show, set, reset, and all_off. Settings are stored in one owner-scoped JSON file and are never inferred from conversation memory.
server_instruction: Use ghost_prompt_settings when the user asks to inspect, set, reset, or disable GHOST prompt-builder flags or default retrieval paths. Use action show to inspect the current values, set with updates to change only named values, reset to restore approved defaults, or all_off to disable every enrichment flag while preserving stored paths and memory_recency_enabled.

field_descriptions.action: Exactly one settings operation: show, set, reset, or all_off.
field_descriptions.updates: Required only for action set. Contains the exact persistent setting values requested by the user.
